in_marathi.name: Ettika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of righteousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ettika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ettika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ettam' which means 'eternal'. The suffix 'ka' is added to denote the feminine gender. Ettika is the goddess of righteousness and virtue, revered in Hindu mythology.
